public_text: The SEC accepts Meta's Q4 2022 results filing; the release lowers the 2023 total-expense outlook and discloses an additional $40 billion share-repurchase authorization.
At its scheduled earnings event, Meta describes 2023 as the Year of Efficiency and focuses on becoming a stronger and more nimble organization.
Meta rises 23.3 percent during the next regular session and leads a broader technology-stock advance.
source_title: How major US stock indexes fared Thursday 2/2/2023
